# Start Forcing Player Outlines

Source: [8803](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8803); edited 2026-04-24. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Forcing Player Outlines](../../api/actions/start-forcing-player-outlines.md).

<a id="wiki-8803-n1"></a>

- Outline configuration is directional between viewed and viewing players; team colors depend on viewer hostility.

<a id="wiki-8803-n2"></a>

- Outline changes may not update immediately: archived table says self updates alive/dead, teammates update within melee distance or on line-of-sight/FOV change (dead works), and living enemies do not update (dead works).

Source limitations:

- Table's Alive/Dead/Other terminology is terse and does not establish all transition details; behavior is archived April 2026.
